title: kiosk-display-auto-sleep-timeout-minutes
description: Payload for the kiosk auto-sleep timeout topics. Published retained by the kiosk node to renewvan/kiosk/display/auto-sleep-timeout-minutes (state), publishing its default (5) on startup if no retained value exists; sent unretained by the dashboard to renewvan/kiosk/display/auto-sleep-timeout-minutes/set (command). Restricted to the dashboard's preset duration picker values.
